operation_details.item: The user's portfolio site is built on a custom WordPress theme.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Hey, I was looking at your portfolio site earlier. The design feels really clean and unique. Did you build it from scratch?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Thanks! It's actually built on a custom WordPress theme I had developed. Gives me a lot of flexibility without starting from zero.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Nice, custom theme makes sense. How many clips do you have up there right now?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I've got twelve published clips featured. I like to keep the selection tight and relevant.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Twelve is a good number. Do you update it often?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I refresh it monthly, usually swap in new pieces and rotate out older ones. Keeps things current.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That's a solid routine. Also, I noticed the contact form on your site—does that go straight to your email?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Yes, it links directly to my email, so potential clients can reach me without any extra steps.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only the platform my portfolio is built on, while keeping the clips, update routine, and contact form details.
